custom_steps:
1. Click work order 1.
  2. Click Add Part in the Parts row of its line, then click More options.
  3. Type the start of part A's description in the Part Number box.
  4. Replace the text with part B's part number.
  5. Click the X at the top right of the New Part Request window.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens on its Lines tab.

Step 2:

  • The New Part Request window opens.

Step 3:

  • The open lookup list holds one line, "No results", in dark text, and nothing else.

Step 4:

  • Part B's result is listed, which shows the lookup is searching.

Step 5:

  • The window closes and the line's Parts row still shows only Add Part: no part was added.
